_comment: Rules run when a scanned file satisfies EVERY criterion in the rule. 'match' is a filename glob; 'columns_all' / 'columns_any' look at the header row, so the file can be called anything. Column names ignore case, spaces and punctuation. Adjust the column lists to your real exports. Rules without agent_id are ignored.

text: Check these invoices against payment and approval policies; flag duplicates, wires above limit and bad GL codes.
Analyse AR aging, predict payment risk and flag customers past 90 days.
Reconcile bank vs GL and list unmatched items.
Check journal entries against approval thresholds and flag missing approvals.
Review the 13-week cash forecast against the minimum cash buffer policy.
Filename-only rule: still supported, and combinable with columns_* when both must hold.
